name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-09-01, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
